title: Triple Hills: Ramesses against Saladin
lede: The Duat Dominion's undead host under Ramesses against Saladin's Muqatila and camel artillery, on Triple Hills. The closest of six: the two armies traded the centre for five rounds, and Saladin's secondaries carried him to 33 VP in Round 6, 33 to 28. Over the six battles Ramesses won 4 to 2, on average 29.8 VP to 23.3. The batch also found an engine bug: Ramesses declared 12 melee attacks and swung in 1.
result_line: Saladin's Army wins on Victory Points, 33 to 28
deployment: The Duat Dominion set up along row 12: Skeletal Spearman 1 with the Canopic Priest at (4,12), Skeletal Spearman 2 at (7,12), the Skeletal Archers at (9,12) and (11,12), the Akhguard at (10,12), the Tomb Fusiliers at (3,12), and Ramesses behind them at (4,14). Saladin set up on row 2: three Muqatila Troopers squads at (3,2), (4,2) and (5,2), the Rammal Geomancer with the first, Saladin with the Abna al-Dawla Guard on the east at (11,2), and the Zamburak Camel-Artillery at (9,2).

1.title: The spears reach the centre first

feed.text: Ramesses gives the Tomb Fusiliers Double Time, and their move needed it. Missions: IRON CURTAIN for the Dominion, FOCUSED FIRE for the Caliphate. Primaries: STRATEGICAL DISRUPTION for Ramesses, DECAPITATION STRIKE for Saladin.

Both armies Advance. The Muqatila squads stop around the centre at (7,5), (6,6) and (5,6); Saladin and his Guard reach the east at (12,6); the Zamburak swings west to (3,5). For the Dominion, Skeletal Spearman 2 reaches the centre at (6,8) and Ramesses comes up to (9,8).
The Tomb Fusiliers take 2 HP off Muqatila Troopers 2.
Skeletal Spearman 2 holds the centre; Saladin holds the east. Ramesses's Army 3, Saladin's Army 2.
Ramesses gives Skeletal Archer 1 Double Time; Saladin spends 3 CP on Secure Objective for Muqatila Troopers 2.

Muqatila Troopers 2 and 3 charge into the centre at (7,7) and (6,7); Skeletal Archer 2 and Ramesses charge back at (8,8) and (8,7); Saladin's Guard charges on the east at (12,7). The Overwatch is messy: Skeletal Archer 1 takes 2 HP off Muqatila Troopers 3, Skeletal Archer 2 puts 4 HP into its own Skeletal Spearman 2 by Friendly Fire, and the Canopic Priest and the Zamburak trade 2 HP each. IRON CURTAIN completes for Ramesses (+2 VP, +1 CP).

Saladin and his Guard destroy Skeletal Archer 1. Ramesses attacks Muqatila Troopers 2 and takes 2 HP from the counterattack without striking back: the engine bug described in the analysis. Skeletal Spearman 2 and Muqatila Troopers 3 trade 3 HP for 4.
Saladin holds all three objectives. Ramesses scores his Primary. Saladin's Army 9, Ramesses's Army 7.
Saladin's Scouting Order on Muqatila Troopers 2 spots the Dominion's HQ.
Skeletal Spearman 1 and the Canopic Priest charge into the centre at (7,8).

The Canopic Priest raises a new Skeletal Spearman squad with Endless Procession at (7,9). The Zamburak takes 6 HP off the Tomb Fusiliers. Ramesses attacks again and again strikes nothing. Muqatila Troopers 3 and the Canopic Priest's spearmen trade 2 for 3.
Ramesses takes back the centre; Saladin holds the west with the Zamburak and the east. Saladin's Army 13, Ramesses's Army 12.

Both sides spend 3 CP on Secure Objective. Ramesses also requisitions a Skeletal Archer squad (3 CP). Saladin's Secure Objective on Muqatila Troopers 1 decides 6 objective VP this round; Ramesses's decides nothing.
The Zamburak destroys the Tomb Fusiliers. Muqatila Troopers 3 takes 5 HP off the Canopic Priest's spearmen.
Saladin holds all three objectives and completes TERRITORIAL SUPERIORITY (+3); Ramesses scores his Primary and IRON GRIP. Saladin's Army 23, Ramesses's Army 16.

Muqatila Troopers 3 destroys the Canopic Priest's spearmen. The Priest raises another squad with Endless Procession at (6,9). The Zamburak and the Abna al-Dawla Guard shoot a Skeletal Archer squad for 5, and Saladin shoots the Dominion's HQ for 4.
Ramesses holds the centre alone and scores his Primary; Saladin holds the west and the east. Saladin's Army 27, Ramesses's Army 21.
Ramesses requisitions one more Skeletal Archer squad and gives it Double Time.
The Akhguard charge Saladin's Guard on the east at (13,8); two raised Skeletal Spearman squads charge at (8,6) and (4,7). COORDINATED PUSH completes for Ramesses (+2).
Saladin and his Guard take 5 HP off the Akhguard and lose 4. A raised spearman squad takes 4 HP off Muqatila Troopers 2.
Ramesses scores the centre and his Primary; Saladin scores the east, STRONGPOINT and TAKE UP THE GAUNTLET (+3), and crosses 30. Saladin's Army 33, Ramesses's Army 28.

analysis.title: Analysis
analysis.html:
Ramesses wins more, on secondaries

Ramesses's Army won 4 of the 6 battles, on average 29.8 VP to 23.3. Objectives were close (17.7 to 15.7 a battle) and so was the Primary (3.0 to 2.2); the gap is the secondaries, 9.2 to 5.5. Damage was even (57.3 a battle to 55.2), and the Dominion lost a little more (28.7 RP to 21.7). Battles ran 5.3 Battle Rounds on average.

{{batch}}{{chart:batch-vp}}{{chart:batch-sources}}

An engine bug: Ramesses did not swing

Ramesses declared 12 melee attacks in the six battles and swung in 1 of them. Each time he took the counterattack and dealt nothing. The cause is in the engine, not the AI. A model carrying two melee weapons swings whichever does more to the defender it is fighting. Ramesses carries the Was-Sceptre and the Four Gilded Hands, and against a Muqatila squad below full strength (or against Saladin) that choice is the Four Gilded Hands. But the attack picks its weapon group before it knows the defender, and picked the Was-Sceptre. The strike then looked for a Was-Sceptre group, found none, and swung nothing. Fixed after this batch: a picked group now stands for its models, whichever weapon they swing. Any model carrying two melee weapons could lose its strike the same way, whenever the defender changed which one it swings. The Duat Dominion's results here and in the Ramesses against Finvarra report understate Ramesses; he still scored 5.6 VP a battle, mostly by standing on objectives (27 objective VP hinged on him), and was never destroyed.

Who scored

The Dominion's cheap infantry carried it. The Skeletal Spearmen (8 RP) scored 2.0 VP a squad, 25.2 per 100 RP, and the Skeletal Archers (10 RP) 2.4, 24.5 per 100 RP, with requisitions and Endless Procession keeping 42 squads on the field over six battles. The Tomb Fusiliers (30 RP) scored 0.3 a battle, 1.1 per 100 RP, and were destroyed in 3 of 7; the Zamburak's fire found them first in the featured battle. For the Caliphate, the Muqatila Troopers (13 RP) scored 2.8 a squad, 21.3 per 100 RP; the Abna al-Dawla Guard 4.0 a battle and Saladin 3.8, 5.0 per 100 RP.

{{chart:batch-unit-vp}}{{chart:batch-unit-vp-rp}}

Commands and identities

  • Matter Transmutation (Caliphate): 32 coatings in six battles, and the record found 26 of them bought nothing: Naft Pitch 13 of 16, Zarnikh Paste 8 of 10, Zi'baq Beads 5 of 6. The coatings are worth a look at the AI's pricing.
  • Endless Procession (Canopic Priest): 12 raisings, 5 of whose squads made a difference the record could see.
  • Secure Objective: Ramesses's 7 decided nothing; Saladin's decided 6 objective VP in Round 4 of the featured battle.
  • DECAPITATION STRIKE, Saladin's Primary in the featured battle, scored nothing: no Caliphate unit ever contested the Dominion's HQ. Saladin shot it for 4 HP in Round 5.
{{chart:batch-unit-inaction}}

How sure

Four to two with the Dominion's most expensive unit unable to fight is a clear lean towards the Dominion, and the bug fix can only push it further. A rerun after the fix would show by how much.

closing: Replay this matchup with the melee fix: Ramesses at full strength should widen the gap. Then the Caliphate's coatings: 26 of 32 bought nothing, which says the AI picks them without asking what the coated weapon will shoot this round.
